portada.titulo: Clean containers, complaints that get an answer.
portada.bajada: SiGeRU connects residents, crews and the municipality: report an overflowing container in seconds, follow its status and help plan collection better.
como.paso1_texto: Every container has a QR code. Scanning it opens the form for that container, no addresses needed.
como.paso2_texto: Overflow, damage, burning or missed collection. If someone already reported it, your report is added to it.
como.paso3_texto: The municipality assigns a crew and, if you have an account, we let you know when it is solved.
como.codigo_label: QR code not working? Type the code printed on the container label:
como.codigo_error: The code starts with CNT followed by numbers, for example CNT-0010.
mapa.texto: Check which containers are available and where to take your recyclables before going out.
mapa.error: The map could not be loaded right now.
perfiles.vecinos_texto: Report problems, check the map and get notified when their reports are solved.
perfiles.cuadrillas_texto: See their tasks and daily route, record every emptied container and the supplies used.
perfiles.operarios_texto: Record waste inflows and outflows, control capacity and machinery status.
perfiles.municipio_texto: Manages containers, fleet and routes, assigns incidents and analyses statistics to decide better.
registro.texto: Residents are enabled immediately. Municipal staff wait until an administrator approves them.
registro.ayuda_clave: At least 10 characters, with upper and lower case letters, numbers and a symbol.
registro.clave_debil: The password does not meet the security policy.
pie.texto: SiGeRU is developed by Aplec Software. Final-year project, Escuela Superior de Informática (UTU), 2026.
